apr 24 Notes:


Doing this journal one day late, but yesterday on friday I took one breakeven trade, and it maybe could have been a no trading day but I tried for a 10:00 long.
,
Going into the market we had an untapped ndog on nq and usually that would be an easy draw for me, but these conditions show otherwise and we also filled it on es, so at least thats something. The overnight session was obviously bullish, but we kind of created a mmbm coming into ny. We had a random pump at 7:00 and that low got taken at least which was enough for me to be bullish. 10:00 opened and we opened lower and then traded higher placing the 10:00 ko in the ote of the range and that was enough for me to go long off of it. It also lined up with a 15m rb. It got a small reaction and then the 10:30 candle opened and gave a good move up instantly which I recognized as manipulation of the new candle so I went breakeven and got stopped out there. Good thing I did too or else I would have lost. If I had entered off of the 5min rb at the bottom, it would have been a winning trade, but I didn’t see it at the time and probably wouldn’t have recognized it as better. (Screenshot 1 & 2)
,
Ending the week in profit, even if it just a little is good. Taking more trades is good for me because I am also learning more lessons as I do so. So 3 trade days a week should be the goal, but nothing forced.
,

My rules: 
(evals)
Risk 300 a trade, If I take a loss I de-risk to 150
MAX 2 trades a day 
1st trade win = lockout for the day

(funded)
same rules as evals but risk 150-200 a trade

A+ setups only

strategy: HTF PDA's + Wick theory/Rejection blocks 

My promise: To document  every trade I take from this point forward on evals, my live account and when I become funded   - any questions or comments are appreciated!
